name: oscars-2026
description: Oscar prediction and watch party app for the 98th Academy Awards
author: Alex Stout

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web & wait
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.deploy:infra: cd infra && npx cdk deploy --all --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build -w web && aws s3 sync web/dist/ s3://oscars-2026-web-134502660579 --delete && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E361RT5DZK8Y9T --paths '/*'
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:infra && npm run deploy:web
